<quote by="Proposed: Casinea, Seconded: Zenith">To construct the edifice "The Black Obelisk" on the Guildenstern estate, Stockmarch, Upwold. To serve as a place of memorial to the herald Obligatus and the landskeeper Geraint Black, leader of the Unbound Union and Keeper of the Prosperity of Afal, following the activity of cultists in Upwold. This is fully self-funded.
</quote>
